s0.ru: Числа Стирлинга первого рода без знака. c(0, 0) = 1, а c(n, 0) = 0 при n больше 0. Дальше c(n, k) = (n-1)*c(n-1, k) + c(n-1, k-1), если предыдущей клетки нет, берите 0. Каково c({n}, {k})?
s0.en: Unsigned Stirling numbers of the first kind. c(0, 0) = 1, and c(n, 0) = 0 when n is greater than 0. Then c(n, k) = (n-1)*c(n-1, k) + c(n-1, k-1). A missing previous cell counts as 0. What is c({n}, {k})?

s1.en: Unsigned Stirling numbers of the first kind. c(0, 0) = 1, and c(n, 0) = 0 when n is greater than 0. Then c(n, k) = (n-1)*c(n-1, k) + c(n-1, k-1). A missing previous cell counts as 0. What is the sum of c({n}, k) for k from 0 to {n}?
